items.title: Mayor’s Announcements
notes:
Budget town hall meetings are coming up. They are open to residents of all wards:
November 4th at the Salvation Army Citadel, 1320 Gordon Street, from 6:30-8:00 pm. 
November 5th, from 6:30-8:00 pm, there will be a virtual Town hall. 
November 6th at the West End Community Centre, 21 Imperial Road, in the Lions Liar room, 6:30-8:00 pm.
November 8th at the Victoria Road Recreation Center, 151 Victoria Road, in the Birch Room from 6:30-8:00 p.m. 
You can also email the mayor at [email protected].

motions.name: Main Motion as Amended
motions.text: That staff be directed to create a new permit-based fireworks by-law to replace and repeal Fireworks By-law (1993)-14362. That council directs staff to exclude "Novelty Devices" (I.e. sparklers and party poppers), as defined by the Explosives Act (Type F) from requiring a permit for their purchase or discharge.
motions.text_html:
1. That staff be directed to create a new permit-based fireworks by-law to replace and repeal Fireworks By-law (1993)-14362.
  2. That council directs staff to exclude "Novelty Devices" (I.e. sparklers and party poppers), as defined by the Explosives Act (Type F) from requiring a permit for their purchase or discharge.

motions.text: That the permitted hours for fireworks be changed from “between 9 a.m. and 11:59 p.m.” to “between 9 a.m. and 11:00PM” That point-of-sale employees be required to provide information on fireworks safety and Guelph rules and guidelines to purchasers of fireworks. That minimum safe distances from residences and all vulnerable occupancies (schools, nursing, and care facilities) be added to the current bylaw
motions.text_html:
1. That the permitted hours for fireworks be changed from “between 9 a.m. and 11:59 p.m.” to “between 9 a.m. and 11:00PM”
  2. That point-of-sale employees be required to provide information on fireworks safety and Guelph rules and guidelines to purchasers of fireworks.
  3. That minimum safe distances from residences and all vulnerable occupancies (schools, nursing, and care facilities) be added to the current bylaw
motions.post_html: The clauses were requested to be voted on separately.
